interpretation: Both competitors complete the basic Korean text-edit/duplicate/undo/persist loop. This does not establish overall Pagecraft superiority.
Deckflow shares targeted source patching with Pagecraft. mncoleman has successful local draft restore and a one-click mobile viewport preset.

Relevant candidate gaps: bounded draft recovery, DOM reorder, and snapping/guides; advanced table/range editing requires larger compatibility design. Pagecraft already has 1440/768/390/fit viewport previews; responsive viewport presets are not a missing capability.

Action counts describe these observed paths. Different storage modes, nonidentical completed task subsets, single fixture and an AI-operated session prevent population-level usability or speed claims.
